concept.hr: Matcher hoda po retku, vraća se unatrag i provjerava sidra
concept.en: The matcher walks the input, backtracks, anchors

summary.hr: Upiši uzorak i redak pa prati pogađanje korak po korak: početni položaji, pohlepni kvantifikatori, točke izbora, BRE, ERE i POSIX.
summary.en: Type a pattern and a line, then step the match: start positions, greedy quantifiers, choice points, BRE, ERE and POSIX.

concept.hr: Vraćanje unatrag javlja prvi pogodak, POSIX najdulji od istog početka
concept.en: Backtracking reports the first match, POSIX the longest from the same start

concept.hr: Ugniježđeni kvantifikatori tjeraju matcher da isproba svaku podjelu retka
concept.en: Nested quantifiers make the matcher try every way to split the line
